latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Professional Development Video — an AI-driven video maker for workforce growth and upskilling.

- Generate video content libraries for career pathing, skill-building, and mentoring programs.
- Supports high-demand skills such as communication, leadership, project management, and data literacy.
- Provides modular, role-aligned video curricula suitable for LMS, manager toolkits, and employee self-serve portals.
- Includes templates for career roadmap videos, mentorship preparation, conference recaps, and high-potential development tracks.
- Enables HR and L&D teams to deliver scalable, on-demand professional development content.
